purpose: Curated public orientation. This directory is not a canonical ontology, a publication inventory, or an assertion that conceptual destinations are publicly accessible.

entries.title: Institution & Stewardship
entries.summary: Purpose, development status, public presence, and stewardship.
entries.detail: The public organizational profile describes Ascendancy Systems as an independent research and development program concerned with knowledge, cognition, complex systems, and technological implementation.

entries.title: Constitution & Governance
entries.summary: Constitutional stewardship and recursive institutional coordination.
entries.detail: The public profile describes constitutional stewardship and identifies governance as a field of inquiry.

entries.title: Canonical Six-Book Series
entries.summary: An orientation to the six-book series as a whole.
entries.detail: The Front Desk names the series as a whole. Individual books and manuscripts have no public edition linked here.

entries.title: Research & Disciplines
entries.summary: The public entry point to the program's intersecting fields of inquiry.
entries.detail: Section III of the public profile introduces six fields. Follow a field on the map to see how the profile describes its work.

entries.title: Foundations & Ethics
entries.detail: The profile names Perceptual Ethics, Regulative Ethics, and Normative Ethics.

entries.title: Systems & Dynamics
entries.summary: Cybernetics, recursion, paradox, and systemic relations.
entries.detail: The profile names Latticeal Cybernetics and Paradox Network Systems Theory.

entries.title: Architectonics & Knowledge Architecture
entries.summary: Structures of knowledge, cognition, interfaces, and experience.
entries.detail: The public profile includes Architectonics, Knowledge Architecture, Interface Architecture, Emotional Architecture, and Psychospatial Architecture.

entries.title: Semantics, Poetics & Embodiment
entries.summary: Meaning, interpretation, aesthetic expression, and poetic structures.
entries.detail: The profile names Field Semantics, Aesthetic Poetics, custodial-architectonic registers, and literature.

entries.title: Governance & Meta-Architecture
entries.summary: Governing structures, recursive coordination, and institutions.
entries.detail: The profile names governing architecture, recursive governance, and institutes and institutions.

entries.title: Research Infrastructure & Experimentation
entries.summary: Repositories, tools, field notes, and experimental practices.
entries.detail: The public profile identifies infrastructure categories while deliberately distinguishing public repositories from private vaults, notes, and unpublished material.

entries.title: Meta-Gauge · MG-001 / GMG-A
entries.summary: A registered orientation instrument and experimental spatial implementation.
entries.detail: The spatial viewer runs from a versioned pose. The separate MG-001 operational record holds the qualitative EF-001 assessment.

entries.title: Continuum & Knowledge Infrastructure
entries.summary: Continuity, memory, and navigation across a developing body of knowledge.
entries.detail: Continuum is listed in the Front Desk as a developing concept in knowledge infrastructure.

entries.title: Cathedral
entries.summary: A symbolic and experiential environment within the broader orientation.
entries.detail: The Front Desk names Cathedral as a developing symbolic and experiential environment.
